format.status: The saved-byte audit reports 7,111,787 finite exterior cells and zero exterior NaNs against the unauthenticated owner-mirror footprint. The generator intended zeros outside, but that per-cell exterior pattern was not independently recomputed. The local strict outside-NaN check fails; this does not establish the cause of the portal range error.
